text: Dans policy-management-api, PUT /policies/{policyId} utilise CreatePolicyRequestDto comme POST /policies. GET /policies trie les résultats du plus récent au plus ancien et prend limit, offset et expand ; GET individuel prend policyId et expand. Les opérations exposent uniquement les réponses 200 indiquées.

Dans insurance-quote-requests, les opérations GET et PATCH portent toutes sur /insurance-quote-requests; PATCH répond avec InsuranceQuoteResponseDto et renvoie InsuranceQuoteRequestDto. Lien au domaine policies via le champ policyId de InsuranceQuoteRequestDto; customerInfo référence CustomerInfoDto du domaine customers.

For customer listing, `filter`, `limit`, and `offset` are optional query parameters; the API definition gives no defaults, constraints, or filter syntax. Customer profile update takes `CustomerProfileDto` and returns `CustomerDto`; the profile fields are not shown on `CustomerDto`.

Dans customer-core-api, PUT /customers/{customerId} et POST /customers acceptent CustomerProfileUpdateRequestDto ; ses champs requis sont city, email, firstname, lastname, postalCode et streetAddress. PUT /customers/{customerId}/address accepte AddressDto avec city, postalCode et streetAddress requis. La mise à jour d’adresse renvoie AddressDto.

GET /customers est paginé (description : 10 entrées par page) et expose les paramètres query filter, limit, offset, fields ; sa réponse PaginatedCustomerResponseDto contient filter, limit, offset, size, customers et _links. GET /customers/{ids} renvoie CustomersResponseDto ; GET /getCustomers/{ids} est l’ancien point d’entrée et seule la réponse 200 est indiquée, sans schéma précisé.

In customer-self-service-api, the customers domain has three operations, all tagged customer-information-holder: fetch customer, register customer, and update address. The supplied contract lists only 200 responses; avoid assuming errors or undocumented _links contents.

Dans insurance-quotes, les réponses fournies indiquent uniquement le statut 200; aucune autre réponse ni paramètre de filtrage n’est spécifié. Distinguer l’identifiant de chemin `id` pour PATCH et `insuranceQuoteRequestId` pour la lecture individuelle.

The demo login is admin@example.com / 1password; the login page's “Fill in” button enters these credentials, then Log in opens /policies. Policy list contains many duplicate quote rows (19 rows observed, mainly 15. Nov 2026, Waiting for Quote).

Les demandes de devis d’assurance sont partagées entre Customer Self-Service (création, suivi et consultation côté client), Policy Management (examen et réponse côté personnel) et leurs stockages; `policyId` relie une demande à une police. Ne pas séparer les domaines en raison de noms source `quotes`, `insurance-quotes` et `insurance-quote-requests`.

Shared data was modified during exploration: Customer Self-Service chat now includes the previously sent blank message and the test message "Could you explain my policy coverage?"; Customer Management Notifications shows Max Mustermann with 2 Messages. Do not send another message using these shared records or assume the original state.

Policy Management exploration changed quote request 20 (timestamp 15. Nov 2026 20:03) to rejected, and quote request 19 (20:02) was also rejected. New contract form failed on empty submission; policy creation not successfully explored. Edit amount fields share the placeholder and could not be targeted distinctly with tools. Do not rely on requests 19/20 remaining open.

Customer Self-Service demo login reaches /policies and displays its own customer policies (Health Insurance: 05. Feb 2018 – 10. Feb 2018, 1500 CHF deductible, 250 CHF premium, 1000000 CHF limit) plus many Waiting for Quote requests. Policy Management has one seeded policy fvo5pkqerr for customer rgpp0wkpec (Max Mustermann); don't mutate seed rows in repeatable tests. Quote requests UI has open request #18 at 15. Nov 2026 20:00; respond writes shared request state and could disrupt later tests.

In Customer Management, search filters by customer name only (not address, email, or phone); the no-match query produced the empty table counter `1 - 0 of 0`. Editing a profile via Save Changes returns to its profile. I changed Ado Kinnett's phone to 055 222 41 12 during exploration and restored it to 055 222 41 11; do not use that profile for further persistent changes.

Customer Self-Service quote request creation succeeds through the wizard; accepted/rejected response journeys are already covered by cross-application repository tests. In Policy Management, newly submitted requests appear at the top with date/time, and Show Details opens its detail. Avoid hardcoded request IDs; timestamps/data are unstable and many rows share the same customer/type.

Quote-request submission from the Customer Self-Service wizard uses a demo customer and defaults the start date to today; the resulting Policy Management detail and customer details are date/time-specific, so tests should target a fresh request via its newest list row rather than fixed IDs. Policy Management can Reject to avoid entering quote amounts, then the customer's rejection is shown in the request detail; archived request list must be enabled to display the rejected status.

At cross-application level, the existing suite already has rejection and acceptance quote-response scenarios (both marked data-write and use fixed request #18); do not duplicate either. The current explored quote requests #31/#32 have been rejected. Customer Self-Service request detail surfaces exact rejection phrase `Lakeside Mutual has rejected this Insurance Quote Request.` but snapshot exact text locator fails because message is inside a timestamped paragraph; use appropriate paragraph scope or avoid duplicate rejection path.

Exploration submitted a Home Insurance quote request (18 Nov 2026 21:24, request id 33) and then rejected it in Policy Management. It remains changed data: request 33 now displays “Lakeside Mutual has rejected this Insurance Quote Request.” Customer Self-Service route /policies shows many identical dated requests, so avoid relying on ambiguous list rows; use unique details route once known. Policy response dialog Reject hides amount/date fields and Send Response updates status.

Exploration submitted a Home Insurance quote request through Customer Self-Service (18 Nov 2026 about 21:29, request id 34) and left it open. This is a write made during exploration; its pending state is now part of shared data. List has many near-identical customer requests, so pick the top newest using its unique timestamp to open details. Existing tests already cover quote request submission and cross-app acceptance/rejection as nonvisual; visual coverage exists for wizard personal data, insurance options, confirmation, existing request details, and Policy Management response dialog.
